KORNELIUSLEMSII H.-Y. Liu, 1989 瑾悬山
"瑾"为美玉名,代指其色;"悬山"是中式建筑的一种屋顶,其特征是檩木出梢,恰似叶尖形.故拟名瑾悬山.

Photos Ray Stephenson
Section Aeonium
莲花掌组
Distribution : South Western Morocco
分布:西南摩洛哥
Description (according to IHSP, 2003) :
描述(根据IHSP,2003):
Perennial rather few-branched subshrubs to 1.5m.
多年生少分枝亚灌木,成株可达1.5m.
Branches ± erect to ascending, often in groups, 10 - 20 mm in diameter, glabrous, smooth.
分枝直立上升,常成群,茎直径10 - 20mm,无毛,光滑.
Rosettes 5 - 17 cm in diameter, centre flattened with young inner leaves thightly appressed to each other.
莲座直径5 - 18cm,生长点附近平坦,新叶相互紧贴.
Leaves 4 - 9 x 2 - 3 cm, 1.5 - 3 mm thick, obovate or obovate-spatulate, apically truncate or rounded, basally cuneate, puberulent, margin with straight or curved cilia (0.4 - 1 mm), pale green to yellowish-green.
叶长4 - 9cm,宽2 - 3cm,厚1.5 - 3mm,叶倒卵形或倒卵状匙形,先端截形或圆形,基部楔形,被微柔毛,边缘具直的或弯曲的纤毛(0.4 - 1mm),叶片呈淡绿色至黄绿色.
Inflorescences 5 - 20 x 5 - 18 cm, peduncle 10 - 13 cm long, pedicels 3 - 8 mm, puberulent.
花序高5 - 20cm,宽5 - 19cm,总花梗长10 - 14cm,花梗长3 - 8mm,被微柔毛.
Flowers 7- to 9-merous, sepals sparsely puberulent to puberulent, petals 4.5 - 6 x 1.5 - 2.5 mm, elliptic, acute, occasionally emarginate, yellow, filaments glabrous.
花基数7 - 9,萼片疏生柔毛到微柔毛,花瓣长4.5 - 6mm,宽1.5 - 2.5mm,椭圆形,尖锐,有时微凹,呈黄色,花丝无毛.
Cytology : 2n=36
染色体:2n=36 即 n=18

野境下的Aeonium korneliuslemsii
Photos Jean-André AudissousAeonium korneliuslemsii 瑾悬山 是一款相当低调的Aeonium,其不具有辨识度的外形成为了硬伤,但事实上,其叶片的质感远胜于与其极其相似的Aeonium arboreum 一脉,并且在Aeonium组中是为数不多的叶被毛品种,这些都决定了他会是一个相当出色的亲本!
